sections.text: Introduction

This document lists the 
maintenance procedure of weld-on electric stop valve, depending on external / 
internal leakage used for feeding the Boiler with the water after feeding pump.

The first draft initiated and 
tested by eng. Fawzy Ahmed Basuoni at 18 Dec 2003, accepted by General Director 
eng. Saad Mostafa, revised by EDEPC eng. Samir Abdel-Gelil, and approved by eng. Awad 
Mohammed Fathy Soliman Head Sector of Talkha power station.
Technical Specification
Safety Precautions

items:
A work permit must be issued and 
 qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
surrounding the work area.
Wear your safety helmet, shoes, etc.

Isolate valve mechanically and 
electrically.

Drain the pipeline, which connected to 
this valve.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.
Suitable lifting device.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Before Isolated 
 the Valve Mechanically & Electrically

Check any leakage from valve gland, if it 
 found, retighten on gland bolts.

Check any leakage from the pressure tight 
 cover, if it found retighten the cover nut.
Check any internal leakage.

Check any leakage from the valve bodies 
 (cracks or mechanical wear). Remark the point of leakage.

Check the operation of the valve drive 
 during closing/ opening of the valve.

sections.text: Disassembly the Valve
Screw off nut (5) of gland bolt (6).
Take up the gland follower (7).
Screw off yoke (2) around valve body (1).
Take out from hand wheel (11) all parts of the valve except body.
Take out cone (3) from spindle (4).
Screw off nut (10) and take out hand wheel (11)
Turn the yoke (2) around spindle (4) until the yoke take out from spindle (4).
Screws off the retaining screw (12).
Take out yoke sleeve (9) from yoke (2).
Take out the gland follower (12).
Take out the gland packing (8), ring (13).

sections.text:
Inspection and 
Repair of All Parts

Check the valves cone (3) and regrind the 
sealing surface of it if needed.
Check the valves seat and regrind it if needed.

Repair the valve cone (3) and valve seat in a specialist workshop if grinding 
can not repair the wear in there. ( in weld type the valve end must be cut from 
the pipe line)
Check the Spindle (4) and repair it if needed or replace it.
Check the yoke sleeve (9) and repair it if needed or replace it.
Checks ring (13) and repair it if needed or replace it.
Check the Gland follower (7) and repair it if needed or replace it.
Clean every connection face.

Check the body (1) from any cracks or wear by using penetration fluids and 
repair it if found by using suitable filler material or its equivalent acc. to 
table (1).

sections.text:
Assembly 
of Valve

Clean every part well before any 
assembly.
Assembly the valve parts in reverse sequence of disassembly.

sections.text:
Replace the 
Packing of Valve Gland

Clean the 
stuffing box chamber and the cover well.
Lubricate the gland bolts and nuts.
Use suitable size of packing.

Wire the suitable packing size on a part of shaft with the same diameter of 
valve spindle.
Cut all packing rings along the shaft by using sharp knife.

Fit the rings in the stuffing box chamber with the cut turned 180 , starting at 
9 clock.
Tight the gland bolts.
Open and close the valve and be sure that the valve operation is correct.
